# What the fixture tooling runs on.  Pinned exactly, not to a range: the
# manifest and the expected output were generated by these versions, and a
# different pylance can write a different file format for the same rows - the
# datasets would still load, and the reference would quietly stop describing
# them.  Bump these together with a regeneration, never on their own.
pylance==11.0.0
pyarrow==25.0.1
numpy==2.5.3
pytest==9.1.1
minio==7.2.20
